Supporters

Support Casomer

Casomer is free for personal sites, and it stays that way. Supporters are the people who make that possible: a one-time contribution that keeps the work going. No paid features, ever. Supporting is thanks, not a plan.

What you get

  • A supporter key, yours to keep.
  • The ♥ heart on your account in Studio: the row in your menu, and the small badge on your avatar.
  • If you like, your name on this wall, with your GitHub handle and an avatar. Optional, and you choose from inside Studio; otherwise you are here as a private supporter, with no name or link.
  • The good feeling. That is the whole list, on purpose: a supporter never has features a non-supporter lacks.

How

Once, or monthly. Your call.

Checkout is handled by Stripe. Your supporter key arrives by email the moment the payment goes through; a monthly supporter gets the same key, and it stays yours if you ever stop. If the email does not arrive, write to support@casomer.com from the address you paid with.

any amount you like

Already a supporter?

In Studio, click your user icon at the top right to open your menu, choose Become a supporter, then I already have a key. Paste the key from your email and press Verify. Studio remembers it on that computer, and the heart appears. Then it asks whether you would like your name on the wall; say yes or not now. Either way you are on it: named, or as a private supporter.

A key starts with CSMR. and verifies on your computer even when you are offline. Nothing about you is sent anywhere unless you join the wall.

The wall

The wall is waiting for its first supporter.

Want your name off the wall? In Studio, open the supporter row in your menu and choose Leave the wall; your card then becomes a private supporter. Anything else, get in touch.
